row.reason: Both are restaurant brand owners that sell prepared food to consumers and earn money from restaurant sales and franchise or licensing. They differ in format and customer occasion. Wendy's is a quick-service burger chain, mostly franchised, with drive-thru and delivery. The ONE Group runs upscale "vibe dining" steakhouse, sushi and teppanyaki restaurants (STK, Benihana, Kona Grill, RA Sushi), mostly company-operated, with some licensing. The restaurant industry and the general consumer diner overlap, but the product, dining occasion and price tier do not, so this is adjacent rather than direct.
